scope: Real ContactStore/ContactService/HTTP; isolated encrypted synthetic journal and model; no owner account or data.

idle.sampling: One-second raw cumulative CPU/time samples; consecutive groups of five, each normalized by its actual elapsed time. Final partial window included. No samples discarded or phase shifting.
idle.boundary: Browser-closed Node Contact host including measurement overhead; fixture HTTP child excluded. Real 1-second timer and 15-minute polls, unchanged empty sources, no clock acceleration. Existing 1-hour model cooldown applies, so this does not independently prove fingerprint suppression. Excludes tray/browser/broker child CPU and real provider execution.
